name: Repaglinide

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypoglycemia : Repaglinide may cause hypoglycemia. Skip the scheduled dose of repaglinide if a meal is skipped to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia. Reduce the dose of repaglinide if hypoglycemia occurs. (5.1) Serious Cardiovascular Adverse Reactions with Concomitant NPH-insulin : Repaglinide…

summary: Official warnings state that Repaglinide can cause hypoglycemia, which is low blood sugar, and patients should skip their dose if they skip a meal to lower this risk [3]. The label also notes serious heart-related problems when this drug is taken together with NPH-insulin [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated the drug's risks, placing both liver and heart concerns in a low score band [M].
